Subject: Re: Sequestered sample exchange & MAP: evaluation access and usage constraints

Marissa —

Thanks for the intro call last week. Tessera is ready to move forward with a short, scoped evaluation of Redwood inference for our product search reranker. We want to exchange a small, sequestered set of testcases (roughly 8–12k rows) and run black‑box evals only — no training, no derivative datasets. Before we proceed procurement needs a short mutual action plan (MAP) that covers: handoff timeline, access method, retention/destruction, usage constraints, auditability, and an acceptance gate (pass/fail criteria).

Key asks from our side:
- Temporary read‑only S3 access (timeboxed) or secure SFTP — we prefer S3 presigned with short TTLs.
- Access restricted to up to 4 designated tester emails.
- Strong non‑derivative language: data may not be used to further train models or redistributed.
- Audit trail of calls / object access for the 45‑day evaluation window.
- Manifest with sample hashes (MD5) and a simple schema so our engineers can validate ingest.

Can you put a short MAP together and include a simple sample manifest and the proposed acceptance test we can run? Procurement (cc'd) would also like a pointer to the security questionnaire / SOC2 evidence.

Best,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Research
Tessera Labs

Attachment: tessera_sequestered_manifest_v1.csv (manifest stub, 12 lines)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@tessera.ai>
Cc: Tessera Procurement <contracts@tesseralabs.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sequestered sample exchange & MAP: evaluation access and usage constraints

Ari —

Thanks — appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a concise MAP and a sample manifest to speed review. High level summary below so your team can scan quickly:

MAP summary (proposed):
1) Signing & gating (2 business days): NDA in place (we have your signed NDA on file). DocuSign link included in attachments.
2) Security review (up to 3 business days): we will provide our SOC2 summary and the security pack link. Procurement can run the checklist.
3) Provisioning (1 business day after gating): ephemeral S3 bucket with pre-signed, timebound URLs (default TTL 48 hours). We will issue four tester keys and rotate presigned tokens on handover.
4) Evaluation window (45 days): read‑only access, split into a 14‑day smoke pass and a 31‑day full sweep.
5) Acceptance gate (plug‑and‑play check): run the provided eval harness (script) on a sealed subset (1k rows) — pass criteria = F1 >= baseline_x OR no regression > delta_y. If acceptance passes, we will discuss extended pilot.
6) Post‑eval: explicit destruction/deprovisioning and certificate of deletion (within 5 business days).

Usage constraints (non‑negotiable):
- No model training or fine‑tuning with the sequestered samples.
- No distribution outside the four named testers.
- No creation of derivative datasets for benchmarking or resale.
- All evaluation logs stored for 45 days and available for audit; access to logs requires 48 hours notice.

Operational details:
- We will provide a CSV manifest (attached) containing filenames, record counts, and MD5 checksums. Please validate checksums on ingest.
- We will watermark the dataset with non‑user PII tags and artifact GUIDs to help provenance tracking.
- If you need a longer TTL for presigned URLs during bulk ingest, we can do a one‑time exception (48 → 96 hours) with a justification.

Timeline suggestion: target handoff week of 2026‑09‑20, evaluation complete by 2026‑11‑04. If you prefer accelerated close, propose 2026‑10‑07 for initial acceptance check.

Attached: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf, redwood-tdr-access-credentials.txt (contains templated instructions for key rotation and S3 bucket path).

Let me know whether procurement needs the SOC2 artifact in full or just the summary. If procurement is fine, I'll create the presigned access and share the manifest.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short 30‑minute handoff next week to walk engineers through the manifest.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415‑555‑0129

Marissa —

This looks good and aligns with what our engineers expected. A couple of quick clarifications before procurement signs off:
1) Can we get the presigned URLs TTL at 72 hours (one‑time) for the bulk validate step?
2) For the acceptance gate: can you share the minimal eval harness (lightweight script) and expected baseline numbers? Our team likes to validate locally before calling the pass/fail.
3) Procurement wants the certificate of deletion to include a signed timestamp and the manifest of deleted objects.

Procurement (cc) — please advise on any contract language that would block the no‑training clause.

If that all looks fine we'll target your proposed accelerated acceptance on 2026‑10‑07 and aim to have the handoff week of 2026‑09‑20.

Thanks,
Ari
